program.name: Single-Leg Power
program.subject: Plyometrics
program.blurb: One leg at a time: hops and stuck landings, then bounds, on the minute and in sets.
program.about: Power one leg at a time. Each day opens with an EMOM, single-leg hops and stuck landings one day, bounds and skaters the next, then straight sets of single-leg strength to finish. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II brings harder variations and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Hops & sticks / bounds & landings, EMOM then sets
